cards.title: Opening
cards.applicability: Initial operation: commander, reachable expansion, scouting and construction.

cards.title: Global strategy
cards.applicability: Choosing or revising the victory course, measurable stages and readiness; stalled conquest.

cards.title: Development
cards.applicability: Economic expansion or income, production, recruitment, delivery and readiness bottlenecks in the saved course/operation.

cards.title: Offensive operation
cards.applicability: Choosing a conquest target or breakthrough; compare continuations, actors and base exposure before acting and after passage opening, capture, losses or reinforcement.

cards.title: Main army idle
cards.applicability: Main army has movement without progress; blocked routes, deadlines or goals.

cards.title: Recovery
cards.applicability: Restoring combat readiness after loss, retreat/surrender or rebuilding; comparing low-mana attack with recovery.

cards.title: Defense
cards.applicability: Protection affected by recall, departure, transfers or opening enemy access; return/interception timing, uncertain threats and several fronts.

cards.title: Town after capture
cards.applicability: Departure after capture/completed hold, renewed holding or base trade.

cards.title: Exploration
cards.applicability: Missing information or routes, keys/borders/passages; scout/collector/helper assignment after confirmed helper loss.

cards.title: Finish the game
cards.applicability: Decisive attack versus minor targets/waiting; elimination and recapture prevention.
